subject: iSMART app — cannot bind vehicle (QR code not showing)
body_text: Hi team, I just bought a used 2024 Aurora EV and the previous owner's account is still bound. I tried scanning the QR code under Add Vehicle but nothing shows on the infotainment screen. Privacy Policy is accepted and date/time/time zone are correct. How do I force unbind and bind it to my account?

subject: Data plan question
body_text: Hello, my 3-year free data plan on the iSMART small tier seems to have reverted. Can you tell me how to upgrade to the medium tier? I can't find the option under Account, Plan.

subject: URGENT — keys locked inside vehicle
body_text: My digital key won't connect and my physical key is locked inside the car. I'm stuck in a parking lot in Toronto. What do I do? Very urgent please.

subject: Going to take this to media
body_text: This is the third time I've contacted you about my broken infotainment and nobody has responded. I will be contacting my lawyer and going public on social media if this isn't resolved by end of week.
